name: Surface Sky Spawn Bridge
scope: Surface-first SKY SPAWN bridge: while actually landed/on-foot, aim the center reticle above the horizon, choose LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH orbital shell, preview the physical insertion and projected orbit, then commit one fixed basalt asteroid exactly along that live surface look ray into the existing mutual Newtonian N-body simulation. The 0.1.0.6A flight sandbox remains only as a secondary engineering path.
sandboxParentsValidated: Any currently landed planet/moon supported by the existing surface stack; SOL acceptance focuses Earth, Moon, Mars, Europa, Titan and Triton where landing is already enabled.
sandboxDynamicsPolicy: Preview is render-only. Commit recomputes a two-body circular state against the parent's current live position/velocity, then inserts the asteroid as a normal gravity source. From that instant onward the existing mutual Newtonian velocity-Verlet N-body integration is authoritative and perturbations/collisions are allowed.
sandboxReferenceStatePolicy: Surface COMMIT re-solves the astronomical observer, parent state, body rotation, reticle look vector and orbital-shell intersection at the exact commit instant. The body is inserted on that line of sight with a circular prograde tangent; subsequent motion is entirely live mutual Newtonian N-body evolution.
sandboxPreviewPolicy: PREVIEW is presentation-only and follows the live landed reticle direction. The amber ghost marker is visually enlarged for aiming, while the committed asteroid retains its physical mass/radius. The projected orbit is a sky presentation of the calculated insertion and never participates in gravity.
flightNavigationPolicy: Gravity solver, velocity-Verlet integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL reference states, planetary rotation, atmospheric optics, landing transitions and takeoff/orbit handoff remain inherited and are not redesigned in 0.1.0.6A.
mobileCachePolicy: Changed shell/style/main/app/renderer/surface-renderer/orbit-sandbox edges are stamped ue0106a1 for Safari/GitHub Pages cache isolation; unchanged validated 0.1.0.5F dependencies deliberately retain their prior URLs.
surfaceSkySpawnPolicy: Actual landed/on-foot surface only; reference SURFACE SKY observer is intentionally excluded. Reticle must be at or above the local horizon. Current landed body is automatically the orbital parent.
